info.title: Nakhla ERP API
info.description: Small business ERP for Saudi Arabia: double-entry accounting, ZATCA Phase 2 e-invoicing, inventory, point of sale and payroll. Every endpoint is scoped to the tenant of the presented credential; there is no cross-tenant route.

apiKey.description: A session token from /api/v1/auth/login, or a long-lived API key.

post.summary: Sign in and receive a session token
